morphology.pattern_note: 纠正数据包的词根误判：dicat 是 cat 的被动形式。di- 与词根连写，不引起词首 c 的变化；可分为 di.cat。表示地点的介词 di 则与后面的词分写。

senses.zh_definition: 被刷上、喷上或涂上油漆，使物体表面着色或受到保护。
senses.en_definition: To be painted or coated with paint.
senses.ms_definition: Disapu atau disembur dengan cat untuk mewarnai atau melindungi permukaan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 被动动词，句子的主语通常是接受涂漆的物体。dicat 本身不表示过去或完成；sudah dicat 表示已经涂漆，akan dicat 表示将要涂漆。通常不能替代染布、染发所用的 dicelup 或 diwarnakan。释义据[DBP：cat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=cat)归纳。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 建筑维修进度汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dinding bangunan sekolah itu akan dicat semula semasa cuti penggal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该校建筑的墙壁将在学期假期期间重新刷漆。
dual_scenarios.en: The walls of the school building will be repainted during the term break.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dinding ni baru dicat, jangan sentuh dulu ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dinding ini baru sahaja dicat. Jangan sentuh dahulu, ya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这面墙刚刷好漆，先别碰哦。
dual_scenarios.en: This wall's just been painted. Don't touch it yet, okay?
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语形式
ya 使提醒的语气较柔和

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.en: Has this wall been painted yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, baru siap tadi. Jangan sentuh dulu ya.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, kerja mengecat baru sahaja selesai tadi. Jangan sentuh dahulu, ya.
messages.zh: 刷好了，刚刚才弄完。先别碰哦。
messages.en: Yes, it was only just finished. Don't touch it yet, okay?

etymology.historical_story: Dicat is formed within Malay by attaching the passive prefix di- to cat, meaning paint. Its connection with mengecat makes the change in viewpoint easy to see: a worker performs the painting, while a wall receives it. The formation remains transparent in present-day Malay, so no speculative story about the distant origin of cat is needed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cat 是漆；前面加 di-，镜头转向被刷的东西：dinding dicat＝墙被刷漆。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性常用词，可用于工程报告或日常交流。提醒他人避开湿漆时，加上 sila 或 ya 能使表达更礼貌。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 说明施工安排或完成情况时适用。正式标示可写 Cat masih basah；不要把 dicat 本身理解成“已经刷好”。
